table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	ServicePurHeader.ServicePurInvCode,
	ServicePurHeader.Date,
	ServicePurHeader.SuppCode,
	AliasName='                     ',
	SupplierBalance = 0,
	DebitOrCredit = ' ',
	ServicePurHeader.UserCode,
	ServicePurHeader.Remarks,
	ServicePurHeader.OriginalDate,
	ServicePurHeader.ModifiedBy,
	ServicePurHeader.PostedBy,
	ServicePurHeader.Posted,
	ServicePurHeader.PostDate,
	ServicePurHeader.HeaderNo,
	ServicePurHeader.DiscPerc,
	ServicePurHeader.FlatDisc,
	ServicePurHeader.MiscCharges,
	ServicePurHeader.CashAccCode,
	ServicePurHeader.CashTendered,
	ServicePurHeader.CashCharged,
	ServicePurHeader.CashBack,
	ServicePurHeader.InvTotal,
	ServicePurHeader.OutStandingAmt,
	ServicePurHeader.Marked,
	ServicePurHeader.Ref1,
	ServicePurHeader.Ref2,
	ServicePurHeader.Ref3,
	ServicePurHeader.Ref4,
	ServicePurHeader.ExpAccCode
FROM  
	ServicePurHeader, 
	Supplier, 
	Accounts, 
	Users
WHERE 
	ServicePurHeader.SuppCode= Supplier.SuppCode AND 
	Users.UserCode = ServicePurHeader.UserCode AND
	ServicePurHeader.SuppCode = Accounts.AccCode AND
	ServicePurHeader.ServicePurInvCode = :ai_Code
